findings.detail:
Russian oligarch connections:
Jack Moshkovich: Stanford grad, joined 8VC 2018 as analyst. Father Vadim Moshkovich founded Rusagro agricultural conglomerate. Sanctioned by EU, UK, Switzerland, Canada, Australia after Russia's 2022 Ukraine invasion for alleged Kremlin ties. Jack obtained US permanent residency summer 2024.

Denis Aven: Joined 8VC 2022. Father Petr Aven is president of Alfa Group (one of Russia's largest financial/industrial consortia). Sanctioned by EU and UK pre-2023, US blacklisted 2023. Per Forbes, Denis was hired after another PE firm refused him due to sanctions concerns.

US National Counterintelligence and Security Center issued bulletin warning Silicon Valley about foreign countries using investment firms to access classified data/technologies. 8VC's defense portfolio includes companies with classified government contracts.

Lonsdale's response: 'strict compliance and legal framework.' No evidence fathers have financial relationship with 8VC. But the counterintelligence concern isn't about money — it's about access to information about defense technology companies through employment at the fund.

Political donations (FEC 2025):
Joe Lonsdale: $80.5K total, all Republican
  - $10K WinRed, $10K Cotton Majority Committee
  - $5K each: WinRed, Republican Majority Fund, Restore Trust PAC
  - $3.5K each: multiple individual Republican campaigns (Womack, Risch, Collins, Mike Lee)
  - Pattern: strategic donations to defense-relevant committee members

8VC model: 25-30% of capital dedicated to co-founding startups through 'Build' program. Recruits 'top-1% specialists like Navy SEALs, Nobel winners, and Palantir alumni.' Focus on 'national capability' companies.

curation.lead:
8VC is a venture capital firm founded by Palantir co-founder Joe Lonsdale, legally structured as Eight Partners LLC and headquartered in Austin, TX. SEC filings record more than 60 fund entities with total committed capital exceeding $6 billion, all listing Lonsdale as sole executive officer [Finding #4749]. The firm's private defense portfolio spans autonomous naval vessels (Saronic), directed-energy counter-drone systems (Epirus), military logistics (Gallatin AI), and other defense contractors, with Alex Moore — Palantir's first employee — running 8VC Defense [Finding #4750]. Company records show 8VC co-founded Epirus through its Build program in 2018, with Lonsdale among the founders [Finding #4593]. 8VC's sole material public equity position is Joby Aviation, which holds $163M in DoD contracts [Finding #5380, Finding #5393].

Forbes reported in August 2024 that 8VC employs sons of two sanctioned Russian oligarchs: Jack Moshkovich (son of EU-sanctioned Vadim Moshkovich, promoted to Partner in January 2025) and Denis Aven (son of OFAC-sanctioned Petr Aven, joined in 2022 after another firm declined him over sanctions concerns) [Finding #4746, Finding #4699]. Lonsdale confirmed the hires and stated the firm operates under a strict compliance framework. The US National Counterintelligence and Security Center has issued bulletins warning that foreign states use employment at investment firms to access information about defense technology companies [Finding #4699]. 8VC also partners with Apollo Global Management on defense, manufacturing, and energy deployment [Connection #2785], and is an investor in Erebor Bank, the digital bank co-founded by Palmer Luckey and Lonsdale [Finding #4752].
curation.system_role: 8VC is a multi-stage venture capital firm that co-founds and invests in defense-technology, healthcare, and enterprise software companies, with a concentrated private portfolio across autonomous defense systems, counter-drone, and military logistics sectors.

sections.title: Key Relationships
sections.content:
Joe Lonsdale is 8VC's founder, managing partner, and sole executive officer on every SEC Form D filing. He co-founded Palantir Technologies with Peter Thiel in 2003 and later founded 8VC; Alex Moore, Palantir's first employee, now runs 8VC Defense [Finding #4750]. 8VC's defense investment strategy draws on direct experience with Palantir's government contracting model.

8VC is an early investor in Anduril Industries, the defense-technology company founded by Palmer Luckey. The 8VC–Anduril–Founders Fund investor overlap extends to Erebor Bank, which Luckey and Lonsdale co-founded with backing from Founders Fund, 8VC, and Lux Capital; the bank targets the defense-tech ecosystem for banking services [Finding #4752]. FEC records show Lonsdale's personal donations of $314K are distributed across members of both the Senate and House Armed Services Committees, including Cotton, Sullivan, Mullin, Scott, Ernst, Crenshaw, and Democratic Ranking Member Adam Smith [Finding #4699].

Jack Moshkovich (Partner, 8VC since 2018) is the son of EU-sanctioned oligarch Vadim Moshkovich. Denis Aven (investor at 8VC since 2022) is the son of OFAC-sanctioned Alfa Group president Petr Aven; Moshkovich introduced Aven to the firm. Neither son is reported to have worked on defense-related deals at 8VC, and no financial relationship between the sanctioned fathers and 8VC has been documented [Finding #4746, Finding #4699].

In October 2025, 8VC entered a strategic partnership with Apollo Global Management to jointly deploy capital in defense, manufacturing, and energy [Connection #2785].

sections.title: Financial Activity
sections.content:
8VC's SEC-registered fund infrastructure comprises more than 60 entities, all Delaware limited partnerships or LLCs, all headquartered at 907 S Congress Ave, Austin TX. Fund VI LP ($998M offering, filed January 2025), Fund V LP ($880M), and multiple prior vintages are registered under CIK numbers 0002041827, 0002051048, 0002056351, and 0002076994. Defense-sector special purpose vehicles include Build Saronic SPV II LLC ($53.35M offering, $47M sold across 27 investors), ERSA SPV LLC ($42.15M fully sold, 30 investors, Epirus-related), and EPSD SPV LLC ($5M, Epirus). Six AI Fund vehicles and multiple Entrepreneurs Fund entities complete the structure [Finding #4749].

8VC GP I LLC (CIK 0001667766) holds Joby Aviation as its sole material public equity position. The position peaked at $101.2M (9.6M shares) in Q2 2025, was halved to 4.8M shares ($77.4M) in Q3 2025, and stood at $63.3M at year-end 2025. Joby holds $163M in DoD contracts under USAF Agility Prime and USSOCOM/CENTCOM logistics programs at MacDill AFB; it partnered with L3Harris on a hybrid VTOL program for military use in August 2025 [Finding #5380, Finding #5393]. 8VC's 13F public equity disclosures do not include Palantir equity despite Lonsdale's co-founder role; SEC filings suggest any such positions are held through personal accounts or limited-partnership interests below the 13F reporting threshold [Finding #5393].

sections.title: Counterintelligence Context
sections.content:
8VC's defense portfolio companies hold classified government contracts. Anduril Industries has $1.43B in all-time DoD obligations and $862M with DHS; Palantir Technologies holds a $10B Army IDIQ and $2.31B in all-time DoD obligations. Saronic, Epirus, Chaos Industries, Gallatin AI, and Overland AI represent additional defense-contract exposure across 8VC's private portfolio [Finding #4750].

The US National Counterintelligence and Security Center has issued public bulletins warning that foreign intelligence services use employment at investment firms — not direct financial investment — to access information about defense technology companies and their classified programs. 8VC's Build program recruits personnel described on 8VC's own website as 'Navy SEALs, Nobel winners, and Palantir alumni' — individuals with operational knowledge of defense systems. Under the NCSC framework, an analyst or partner with board-level access to a defense contractor, regardless of personal conduct, constitutes a potential access point [Finding #4699].

Jack Moshkovich's father Vadim Moshkovich founded Rusagro and, per InformNapalm reporting, also founded AssistAgro, a Ukrainian drone production company. Denis Aven's father Petr Aven was co-founder and longtime president of Alfa Group, one of Russia's largest financial-industrial consortia, with documented contacts to senior FSB and Kremlin officials per the OFAC designation. Lonsdale stated no evidence exists of a financial relationship between either father and 8VC, and confirmed a strict compliance framework. No primary-source evidence contradicts this statement [Finding #4746, Finding #4699].

Founders Fund, 8VC, and Palantir Technologies share three co-founders — Thiel, Lonsdale, and Rabois — who operate across investment, government-placement, and financial infrastructure functions including Erebor Bank [Finding #4752, Finding #4750].

open_questions: Do the 8VC Build program co-founders — who are described as holding security-clearance-eligible backgrounds (Navy SEALs, Palantir alumni) — hold active clearances at the time of hiring, and does 8VC's clearance management process address family-of-sanctioned-person hiring?

What specific due diligence process did 8VC apply when hiring Jack Moshkovich and Denis Aven, and did it include NCSC counterintelligence guidance on access-risk from family relationships to sanctioned persons?

The halving of 8VC's Joby Aviation position (9.6M to 4.8M shares, Q2–Q3 2025) preceded the L3Harris VTOL partnership announcement in August 2025. What was the timing relative to any non-public contract news, and did 8VC or Lonsdale hold any advisory roles with Joby or DoD programs that would create material non-public information exposure?

The 8VC–Apollo Global Management partnership (October 2025) targets defense, manufacturing, and energy. What is the deal-origination structure: does 8VC contribute portfolio company relationships, or does it contribute LP capital? The answer determines whether this is a conflict of interest for 8VC's existing portfolio company relationships with Apollo.

Erebor Bank received OCC conditional approval in approximately four months — a timeline described by Comptroller Jonathan Gould as the first new national bank charter in four years. What was the formal application timeline, and which OCC staff were involved in the review? Did Lonsdale's concurrent role as a DOGE advisor create any contact with OCC personnel outside the standard charter application process?
